# Part VII: Finding Hidden Patterns {.unnumbered}

Often there are no past findings to learn from. The question is simply what in the data does not fit. This part covers methods that find structure, and the cases that break it.

Principal components reduce many indicators to a few. Clustering groups units by behaviour. Association rules find items, or bidders, that go together. Time series show trend and season, and test whether this year's figures are believable. Anomaly detection, from boxplots to isolation forests, ranks the records that stand apart.
